harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 42 requests of probe.py 34 (twelfth build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions: THE YIELD FLAG ON THE WAITING WORD OF THE DIAGNOSTIC OF THE WAIT BEHIND ONE PRODUCER - the producer alone on write barrier 1, its destination holding a marker from the top of every iteration, the word that carries the wait behind it, the producer's stall count = the distance of the waiting word, 1 and 2 cycles; NO yield flag on the producer. Twenty-one producers, two requests each: y_<x> = "rflag": "set" - THE WORD THAT CARRIES THE WAIT CARRIES THE YIELD FLAG; y_<x>_0 = the same text without it. The producers: `SHFL.IDX` (y_shi), `SHFL.BFLY` with its served reader `SEL` (y_sbf), `MUFU.EX2` (y_mex), `MUFU.RCP` (y_mrc), `MUFU.LG2` read in place by its served reader `FADD.FTZ` (y_mlg), `LDS` (y_lds), `LDS.128` (y_l128), `LDC` (y_ldc), `LDC.64` (y_lc64), the register-indexed `LDC` (y_lcx), `LDG.E` (y_ldg), `@P0 LDG.E.CONSTANT` (y_lgc), `LDG.E` waited by a word that is not its reader (y_lgo: the flag stands on that word), `LDCU` (y_lcu), `LDCU.64` (y_lcu64), `S2R R32, SR_CgaCtaId` (y_s2r), `S2R R32, SR_LTMASK` (y_ltm), `S2R R32, SR_TID.X` with its served reader `SHF.R.U32.HI` (y_tid), `I2F.RP` (y_i2f), `S2UR UR12, SR_CgaCtaId` (y_s2ur) and `POPC R32, R21` (y_popc). The batch holds no control without barrier and wait: for sixteen of the producers that control stands in the result files of the earlier batches of this diagnostic, for `LDS`, `LDC`, `LDG.E` (both forms) and `POPC` in the batch that follows this one. Fronts: no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front

conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
